subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Due to the weather forecast that it is going to rain heavily here, all the arrangements are in __turmoil.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Peace**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Turmoil **means a state of great disturbance, confusion, or uncertainty. (अत्यधिक अशांति, भ्रम या अनिश्चितता की स्थिति)

 
 
• **Example**: *The political unrest in the country led to a state of turmoil, with protests and demonstrations filling the streets.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Peace **means a state of tranquillity or calmness. (शांति की अवस्था)
 
 
• **Example**: *After years of conflict, the signing of the peace treaty brought a much-needed sense of peace to the war-torn region.*
 
 

Therefore, **Option 1** is the correct answer as it is the opposite of the underlined word 'turmoil'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commotion **means a state of noisy confusion or disturbance. (शोर-शराबे या अशांति की स्थिति)
 
• **Fuss **means unnecessary excitement or activity. (अनावश्यक उत्साह या गतिविधि)
 
• **Uproar **means a loud and impassioned noise or disturbance. (तेज़ और भावशून्य शोर या अशांति)

38:Tb4d,
The correct answer is **'Option 4) are you interested in watching'.**
